thread:
maria: linking the postmortem for the last two rollouts — same pattern: tiny canary + no auto-rollback + aggressive ramp = unexpected blast radius. thinking we need concrete follow-ups we can ship quickly. TL;DR: auto-rollback rules, default flag scoping, sampling increases, and a concise rollback runbook.

thomas: +1. can we define measurable thresholds? my suggestion: error_rate_pct_delta > 1.5x for 3 consecutive minutes OR p95_latency_delta > 200ms sustained for 3 minutes -> trigger auto-rollback. also need hysteresis so flapping doesn't oscillate.

oliver: also add a floor on canary population. default to 5% for any new flag, require manual override to go above 20% for the first 24h. :eyes:

maria: proposal for owners/timeline:
- Auto-rollback prototype (infra + runtime hooks) -> thomas -> prototype in 2 weeks, staging test in 3 weeks, safe rollout in 6 weeks.
- Flag scoping policy (defaults + progressive ramps) -> ana -> RFC by EOD Wed, policy doc in 1 week.
- Telemetry & alerting (delta detector, noisy-fingerprint filter) -> oliver -> alerts & dashboards in 2 weeks.
- Rollback runbook rewrite + tabletop -> maria -> draft 3 days, tabletop within 10 days.

ana: I can take flag policy. I'll need the incidents export and a short list of examples to codify exceptions. @sre-bot can you dump last 12 months?

sre-bot: export queued: incidents_12m.csv -> https://redwood.internal/artifacts/incidents_12m.csv (ready)

thomas: I'll start the auto-rollback prototype in infra/rollouts/auto-rollback branch. plan: a soft-fail mode that emits a `rollback_recommendation` event but doesn't kill traffic, then a hard mode that flips the flag. we should expose a global kill switch endpoint `/ops/rollouts/kill-switch` guarded by 2FA and audit logs.

oliver: we should also add a sampling simulator so we can run synthetic traffic against thresholds in staging. i'll build a small harness that replays historical traces at N scale to validate.

maria: action tracker (short):
- AR-1: Auto-rollback soft-mode prototype -> thomas -> due: +14d
- AR-2: Kill-switch + 2FA endpoint -> eng-sre + deploy-bot -> due: +21d
- AR-3: Default flag scope policy RFC -> ana -> due: Wed EOD
- AR-4: Telemetry delta detector + dashboard -> oliver -> due: +14d
- AR-5: Rollback runbook draft & tabletop -> maria -> draft+tabletop: +10d
- AR-6: Sampling simulator & staging validation -> oliver -> due: +18d

maria: risks/notes: need clear rollback audit trail (who/when/why), provide automatic post-rollback incident pings to oncall, and ensure we don't auto-rollback low-impact feature changes (feature categories whitelist).

thomas: note: auto-rollback must be model-aware for multi-variant experiments. we should scope by experiment id.

oliver: +1 to experiment scoping. also, add an opt-out list for business-critical flags with explicit approval flow.

maria: sweet. i'll create a small GH issue per AR and link to this thread. next sync: Thurs 10:00am for initial walk-through. react if timing bad. :thumbsup:
